title: Extension of hypercyclic and frequently hypercyclic subspaces
summary: We focus on the existence of large linear structures within the sets of hypercyclic and frequently hypercyclic vectors. For operators $T$ satisfying Kitai's Criterion or the Frequent Hypercyclicity Criterion, we analyze the fundamental linear space $\{f(T)x | f \in H(\mathbb{C})\}$, studied by Herrero, Bourdon, Bès, Wengenroth, and many others. We show that the set $\{f(T)x | f \in H(\mathbb{C})\}$ can be extended within $HC(T) \cup \{0\}$ or $FHC(T) \cup \{0\}$ if $x \in HC(T)$ or $x \in FHC(T)$, respectively.
